rules.source: Natura/BaseCropWorldgen: placement needs soil and light

entries.name: Cinderpearl
entries.note: Requires biome topBlock=sand, temperature > 1 and height at/below world height. RWG Hot Desert has temperature 1, so its name alone does not qualify.
entries.zhNote: 需群系 topBlock 为沙、温度严格大于 1，且生成高度不超过世界高度上限；RWG 的 Hot Desert 温度为 1，不能按沙漠名称推断。当前未核实到支持群系池中的匹配。

entries.name: Shimmerleaf
entries.note: Generated around successful silverwood trees; requires grass.
entries.zhNote: 随成功生成的银树在周围生成，需草方块。

entries.name: Mystical flowers (16 colors)
entries.note: GTNH restricts natural flowers to Ross 128b (dimension 64).
entries.zhNote: GTNH 将自然生成限定在罗斯 128b（维度 64）。
